edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the transfer sender via _msgSender() inside _transfer, allowing caller-controlled source address.
block.timestamp is compared against _lastBuyTime + sellingCoolDown in the anti-dump branch of _transfer.
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap addLiquidity deadline in addLiquidity.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
_transfer calls swapAndLiquify when contract balance exceeds the threshold, initiating an external ETH transfer path.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer to apply balances.
_tokenTransfer mutates the _rOwned reflection balances of sender and recipient.
swapAndLiquify calls sendETHTodev which performs an external ETH transfer to the dev wallet.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth to convert contract tokens to ETH.
sendETHTodev executes the external transfer() call to _devWalletAddress.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap external call.
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH external call.
The external ETH transfer can re-enter swapAndLiquify/_transfer before state is settled if the recipient is a contract.
_devWalletAddress is the recipient of the ETH transfer in sendETHTodev.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the swap call in swapTokensForEth.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to set _lastBuyTime and enforce the sell cooldown.
inSwapAndLiquify is set/cleared by the lockTheSwap modifier protecting swapAndLiquify.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates whether swapAndLiquify is triggered in _transfer.
_antidump selects the sell-restriction branch inside _transfer.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer amount checked in _transfer.
numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity is the threshold compared against the contract balance in _transfer.
sellingCoolDown is added to _lastBuyTime in the timestamp-based anti-dump check.
_lastBuyTime[to] is written and read in the anti-dump logic of _transfer.
_isBlackListedBot is checked for to, msg.sender and from in _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFee determines whether fees are taken in _transfer.
_taxFee is consumed when computing transfer values in the _tokenTransfer flow.
_liquidityFee is consumed when computing transfer values in the _tokenTransfer flow.
balanceOf reads _rOwned[account] via tokenFromReflection.
_rTotal is decremented by the reflection fee during transfers, affecting the reflection rate used in arithmetic.
setDevFeeDisabled writes swapAndLiquifyEnabled after an inline msg.sender equality check against _devWalletAddress.
antidumpStatus is onlyOwner and writes _antidump.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled is onlyOwner and writes swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
changeAntiDumpTime is onlyOwner and writes sellingCoolDown.
setDevFeeDisabled authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to _devWalletAddress.
Address.sendValue performs a low-level call{value} that can re-enter the token flow if used with contract recipients.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
contractTokenBalance parameter determines the amount swapped in swapAndLiquify.
newBalance computed from contract ETH is forwarded through sendETHTodev.
amount parameter is the ETH value passed to the external transfer in sendETHTodev.

normalization_plan.reason: amount is an argument consumed directly by _transfer's validation and balance logic.
takeFee is a transient flag local to _transfer controlling fee application.
contractTokenBalance is the input amount swapped inside swapAndLiquify.
newBalance is a temporary ETH amount derived and forwarded within swapAndLiquify.
tokenAmount is the argument approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
amount is directly the value sent by the external transfer call.
